name: Trigram / N-Gram Token Substring Matching for Technical Error Logs
description: In observability platforms (Datadog, Splunk), engineers search stack traces with partial error signatures. Trigram decomposition enables robust partial substring index matching.
prompt:
In observability platforms (Datadog, Splunk), engineers search stack traces with partial error signatures. Trigram decomposition enables robust partial substring index matching.

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: log_id, error_message, classified_signature.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- Find logs matching 'NullPointer' or 'OutOfMemory' error signatures
            SELECT 
                log_id,
                error_message,
                CASE 
                    WHEN error_message LIKE '%NullPointer%' THEN 'NPE_EXCEPTION'
                    WHEN error_message LIKE '%OutOfMemory%' THEN 'OOM_KILL'
                    ELSE 'OTHER'
                END AS classified_signature
            FROM incident_logs
            WHERE error_message LIKE '%NullPointer%' 
               OR error_message LIKE '%OutOfMemory%'
            ORDER BY log_id;
why_it_fails: Full regex evaluations on raw million-line log tables trigger catastrophic backtracking.
